description: 社會福利統計_臺北市災害救助 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府社會局. 社會福利統計災害救助資料呈現於【社會局局網 統計資料 預告統計資料發布時間表】. Coverage: 臺北市政府社會局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府社會局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
